q: Kafka on the Shore by Haruki Murakami

first_sentence: «Com que então estás safo em matéria de dinheiro, não é?», diz o rapaz chamado Corvo na voz monótona do costume.
"så du lyckades skaffa fram pengar?" frågar pojken som kallas Kråkan lite släpigt

"So you're all set for money, then?" the boy named Crow asks in his characteristic sluggish voice. The kind of voice you have when you've just woken up and your mouth still feels heavy and dull. But he's just pretending. He's totally awake. As always.
‘Dus het geld heb je nu zo’n beetje bij elkaar?’ vraagt de jongen die Kraai wordt genoemd.
